messages:
maria: FYI — our nightly SBOM scan flagged a HIGH CVE in OpenSSL affecting our alpine:3.18-derived baseimage used by runtime containers. Need triage and plan.
aj: ack. which CVE id?
maria: CVE-2026-9999 (placeholder for conversation), affects libssl crypto API. Exploitability flagged for local privilege escalation in older builds.
lee: do we know which images use the vulnerable layer? I can grep image manifests.
sally: I pulled the SBOM: runtime-prod:v2026-03-18, worker-lambda:v3, and builder-helper:v1.2 have the package.
aj: quick mitigation options: 1) rebuild baseimage to alpine:3.19 with patched openssl, 2) patch in-place with backported libssl package, 3) runtime mitigation (dropcapabilities, tighten seccomp/rlimit).
maria: priority = runtime-prod and worker-lambda. Builder-helper lower. Need decision on canary schedule.
lee: suggest canary: 2 nodes in eu-west-1, 1 node in us-west-2 for cross-region. Smoke tests: health, kv-cache warm, inference latency under 99th perc baseline.
sally: inventory + owner ping: @platform-team for runtime-prod, @ml-runtime for worker-lambda.
aj: to build: Dockerfile snippet we should use —

```Dockerfile
FROM alpine:3.19
RUN apk add --no-cache openssl=3.1.3-r0 ca-certificates
COPY rootfs/ /
```

aj: also add reproducible tags and image signing via cosign before pushing. deploy-bot: queued build job #4571 for runtime-prod (automated).
deploy-bot: build #4571 started on ci-runner-12. logs: https://ci.internal/build/4571
maria: test matrix: canary rebuild -> perf tests -> security scan -> PSP check -> rollout if green. Estimated timeline 3-4 hours for canary.
lee: one risk: glibc linkage in some helper images. alpine uses musl; if we rebuild to glibc-based variant to match other stacks, need runtime compatibility checks.
aj: prefer staying musl/alpine to keep image size small. If we need glibc-only fixes, consider multi-arch variant for affected images.
sally: audit logging request: once canary deploys, ensure KMS key access events logged and RBAC change for build service recorded. I'll open an audit ticket.
maria: good call. Also rotate KMS wrapping key for service account after push, but schedule after successful rollout to avoid CI failures.
lee: add temporary network egress block for builder-helper to reduce blast radius until patched image is rolled.
aj: I'll draft the rollback command for quick revert if canary fails: `kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime-container=runtime-prod:v2026-03-17 --namespace=prod`
sally: noted. I'll tag postmortem template and link to runbook: /docs/runbooks/baseimage-hotpatch.md
maria: decision: proceed with rebuild to alpine:3.19, run canary in eu-west-1/us-west-2, run full security scan + smoke perf, sign images, then rollout with 15% traffic for 1 hour, then 50% for 2 hours, then full if green.
lee: I'll run the manifest grep and confirm no other images. Expect results in ~20m.
aj: I'll queue the rebuilds and add package pinning in our baseimage repo. ETA for build artifacts 45m.
sally: I'll create the audit ticket and add RBAC/KMS checklist.
maria: thanks team. If anything blocks, ping here. :thumbsup:
